description: Iterates the logistic map one step per clock pulse and puts the result out as a voltage

params.text: Sets r, the multiplier in the logistic map, 1.1 to 3.9
Scales the r input from nothing to its full voltage before it is added to the r knob, 0 to 1
Forces the map's value back to the reset setting and holds it there for as long as the button is pressed
Sets the value the map is forced back to on a reset, 0.1 to 0.9
Slows the output's move to each new value, 0 to 1; at 0 it steps almost straight there and at 1 it slides over a fraction of a second

inputs.text: A rising edge computes the next iteration of the map
Added to the r knob after the attenuator, with the total clamped to the 1.1 to 3.9 range
A rising edge forces the map's value back to the reset knob's setting
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the slew is set by its knob alone, despite the maker's README listing a slew CV input

outputs.text: Carries the map's current value scaled to 0 to 5V

notes: nothing changes until a clock or a trigger reaches the tick jack, and the value holds between pulses
the picture plots the map's settled values against r with the current r marked across it; it is a drawing and clicking it does nothing

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
